about.title: About me-ish
about.lead: me-ish is an online gallery where anyone can showcase their work in their own unique way. We update the viewing experience with 3D presentation and original UI, designing how art is presented and discovered.
about.statsNote: * Payment by credit card (JPY) only. Artist payouts are made monthly via bank transfer after deducting a 10% commission from sales. See FAQ for details.

stats.sellSub: Only on sales / Zero cost if nothing sells
stats.settingsSub: Set sale status, price & edition at application

features.title: Experience designed for art
features.body: UI elements like holographic labels and spatial staging maximize the appeal of each artwork.

features.title: Simple exhibition flow
features.body: Guided application — no confusion. Sale settings and pricing are handled entirely in the form.

features.title: Image protection & safe operation
features.body: Multi-layered protection including signatures/watermarks and AI recognition disruption. Policies are clearly in place.

steps.d: Enter artwork details and upload your image. Just follow the guide.
Quick review against basic standards. Results notified by email.
Listed in galleries like White / Float. SOLD and edition info shown automatically.
Credit card payment (JPY). SOLD appears on the artwork page once purchased.
Sales paid monthly via bank transfer per policy. Details viewable in My Page.

recommend: Artists who want their work seen, regardless of title or track record
Those who care about how their art is presented
Anyone who wants to enjoy art casually, even on mobile
Collectors looking to discover new talent
about.protectionBody: Display images receive protections such as signature recommendations, watermarks, and AI recognition disruption. Policies for original data handling, secondary use, and deletion requests will be published in phases.
about.whyBody: We wanted to create a space where anyone can exhibit based on the work itself, not their background or credentials. me-ish is designed as an accessible starting point — easy for first-timers to try, and safe to exhibit in.

pricing.title: Plans & Pricing
pricing.guaranteeDesc: Within the valid period from purchase, your artwork is guaranteed to be displayed the specified number of times (general rotation continues separately).
pricing.feeItem1: Sales commission is 10%, charged only on successful sales. Commission is deducted from sales and paid monthly via bank transfer (bank account registration required at application).
pricing.feeItem2: Buyers pay by credit card (JPY). Cryptocurrency payments are not supported.

termsItems.title: Artwork Rights & Protection
termsItems.body: Copyright remains with the artist. We request a license to use your work for exhibition, sales, and promotion. Signatures/watermarks and AI recognition disruption (e.g., Glaze) are applied — artwork is only displayed after protection is complete.

termsItems.title: Review & Listing
termsItems.body: Applying does not guarantee listing. Works go live after passing review (result notified by email). Display continues even after SOLD.

termsItems.title: Guaranteed Display Policy
termsItems.body: Options are purchased per artwork and guaranteed displays are fulfilled within the valid period. General rotation continues after the guarantee is fulfilled.

termsItems.title: Cancellations & Refunds
termsItems.body: Guaranteed display options are non-refundable after purchase by nature (except in cases of legal defect).

pricing.ctaNote: Apply for free first. Listing begins after review approval.

creators.title: Exhibition Guide
creators.lead: me-ish is an online gallery where anyone can exhibit their work in their own way, regardless of background or experience. Applying is simple. Image protection is handled by us. You choose whether to sell at the time of application.
creators.statsNote: * Artist payouts are made monthly via bank transfer after deducting a 10% commission. See FAQ for timing and breakdown.

stats.sellSub: Only on sales / Zero cost if nothing sells

checklist: Artwork image (recommended: 3000px long side / JPG or PNG / sRGB)
Sales settings (optional): sell or not, price, edition size
Signature (optional / if included, watermark may be omitted)
Bank account details (required for monthly payouts if selling)
creators.checklistNote: * See FAQ: Image Guide for detailed image requirements.

flow.title: Submit the application form
flow.body: Enter artwork details and upload your image. If selling, set price and edition size.

flow.title: Content review by team
flow.body: Check for public decency and rights. Estimated time: 1–2 business days.

flow.title: Image protection processing
flow.body: Signature recommended / watermark and AI recognition disruption (e.g., Glaze/steganography) applied.

flow.title: Exhibition & sales start
flow.body: Listed in the gallery. SOLD and edition info displayed automatically. (Display continues after SOLD.)

flow.title: Payment & payout
flow.body: Buyers pay by credit card (JPY). Sales paid monthly via bank transfer after deducting a 10% commission.

policy: Exhibited works receive signature recommendations, watermarks, and AI recognition disruption.
We verify originality, public decency, and rights clearance.
Works generated entirely by AI (with little to no human creativity) are not accepted. If AI was used, please declare it in the designated field at application.
Minor resizing or compression may be applied to optimize display.
creators.moreExposureBody: Optional guaranteed display plans ensure a minimum number of showings. See Plans & Pricing for details.

buyers.title: Buyer's Guide
buyers.lead: Anyone can freely view exhibited works on me-ish. You can purchase works you love right on the spot. Payment is by credit card (JPY) only.

flow.title: Open an artwork
flow.body: Tap on an artwork in the gallery to view the price and description.

flow.title: Start purchase
flow.body: Tap 'Buy Now' to proceed (only shown when stock is available).

flow.title: Receive your file
flow.body: After purchase, a download link will be sent to your email.

buyers.flowNote: * After purchase, SOLD appears on the artwork, which continues to be displayed in the gallery during its exhibition period (for the viewing experience).
protectionItems: Display images have watermarks and AI recognition disruption (e.g., Glaze) applied.
Purchased data may only be used for personal viewing (copyright is not transferred).

faqItems.q: Q. What payment methods are accepted?
faqItems.a: → Credit card (JPY) only. Cryptocurrency payments are not supported.

faqItems.q: Q. Can I cancel or return a purchase?
faqItems.a: → Due to the nature of digital goods, cancellations are generally not accepted. Please contact us for accidental purchases.
